name: Ticket to Ride

categories.label: Claimed routes
categories.help: Points for the routes you claimed, by route length.

categories.label: Completed tickets
categories.help: Total value of destination tickets you connected.

categories.label: Failed tickets
categories.help: Total value of destination tickets you did not connect (enter as a positive number).

categories.label: Longest path bonus
categories.help: Tick if you own the longest continuous path (10 points; tied players all score it).

categories.label: Tickets completed (count)
categories.help: How many tickets you completed; the most wins a tie.

notes: Base USA map. Map-specific bonuses (such as stations) are out of scope. Category list recalled from the publisher rulebook and not yet re-checked against the printed copy (see source.checked_against_rulebook).
